UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Unified login RBAC profile mapping a Firebase Auth UID to its portal role, contact info, map-pinned addresses, loyalty points, and theme preference.

role.description: Assigned RBAC role used by Unified Login routing.

customerCode.description: Unique 4-digit customer code (EDK-USR-XXXX) generated upon customer registration or first login.

referralCode.description: Unique referral code (AGENT-XXXX) when role is sales_agent.

referredByCode.description: Referral code (AGENT-XXXX) that referred this account.

referredByAgentId.description: Sales Agent UID that referred this account.

requiresEmailVerification.description: Whether newly registered store or sales_agent account requires Firebase emailVerified before portal access.

lastReviewPromptAtIso.description: ISO timestamp of last Google Play in-app review prompt.

isBanned.description: Whether the customer account is banned by Admin from placing new orders.

banType.description: Ban severity tier applied by Admin.

banUntilIso.description: ISO expiration timestamp for temporary_24h bans.

name.description: Display name of the account holder.

phone.description: Customer or user Egyptian mobile number.

defaultAddress.description: Default street and building address in Edku.

defaultLat.description: Pinned default delivery latitude in Edku.

defaultLng.description: Pinned default delivery longitude in Edku.

profileCompleted.description: Whether Google or Email customer completed phone and map location onboarding.

favoriteStoreIds.description: Bounded list (up to 50) of favorite store IDs.

savedAddresses.description: Bounded list (up to 10) of saved Edku delivery addresses with map coordinates.

storeId.description: Linked store document ID in /stores when role is store.

walletBalance.description: Customer EGP wallet balance approved via Admin top-ups or refunds.

totalSpentEgp.description: Cumulative EGP spent across orders for unlocking Top Rated section.

lastRefundOrderId.description: Order ID used to verify atomic wallet refund upon cancellation.

currentStreak.description: Consecutive delivered orders progress toward Streak 5 reward.

freeDeliveryRewards.description: Earned free delivery vouchers from Streak 5.

lastDeliveredOrderAtIso.description: ISO timestamp of most recent delivered order.

lastSpinDate.description: ISO timestamp of last Daily Spin execution (24h cooldown).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile update.

CustomerDirectoryEntry.title: CustomerDirectoryEntry
CustomerDirectoryEntry.description: Non-PII customer loyalty directory entry for real-time points, streaks, and Admin points management.

customerCode.description: Mirrored unique customer code (EDK-USR-XXXX) for Admin directory search.

isBanned.description: Mirrored customer ban flag for real-time Admin status display.

banUntilIso.description: Mirrored ISO expiration timestamp for temporary_24h bans.

totalSpentEgp.description: Mirrored cumulative customer spend in EGP.

lastDeliveredOrderAtIso.description: ISO timestamp of last completed delivery.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last points update.

Store.title: Store
Store.description: Local merchant, restaurant, bakery, supermarket, or pharmacy in Edku city with uploaded image, pinned map coordinates, and aggregate review ratings.

name.description: Arabic display name of the store in Edku.

isHomeFood.description: Special badge flag marking authentic home-cooked food providers in Edku.

neighborhood.description: Neighborhood or street in Edku city.

deliveryFee.description: Base store delivery fee in EGP (0 to 250).

deliveryTimeMinutes.description: Estimated delivery duration in minutes (10 to 120).

lat.description: Pinned store latitude coordinate in Edku city.

lng.description: Pinned store longitude coordinate in Edku city.

imageUrl.description: Compressed device-uploaded store image Data URL or HTTPS URL.

isActive.description: Whether the store is active on the platform.

prepTimeMinutes.description: Default expected preparation time in minutes (5 to 180).

minOrderAmount.description: Minimum order subtotal in EGP (0 to 5000).

menuItems.description: Bounded preview list (1 to 8) of store menu items.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the dedicated store owner login.

referredByAgentId.description: Optional Sales Agent UID who onboarded this store.

referredByCode.description: Optional referral code (AGENT-XXXX) used during store onboarding.

inviteToken.description: Optional invitation token used during self-onboarding.

createdBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

StoreCredential.title: StoreCredential
StoreCredential.description: Admin-only isolated store owner contact and generated @adkawy.com login credentials.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Store product or Mystery Box offer with mandatory device-uploaded photo and live inventory stock.

hasVariants.description: Whether product uses smart variants (sizes, colors, shades, portions).

variants.description: Bounded list (<= 25) of ProductVariant maps with per-variant price and stock.

isMysteryBox.description: Whether this item is a discounted Mystery Box.

originalValueEgp.description: Original value before Mystery Box discount.

isFlashSale.description: Whether product is currently on Flash Sale.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Delivery or 4-stage Pharmacy Prescription order with map coordinates, scheduling, group cart link, and loyalty points.

cancelledByCourierIds.description: Bounded list (<= 20) of courier UIDs who accepted and then cancelled/released this order.

rejectedBy.description: Bounded list (<= 30) of courier UIDs who rejected this order.

isTestSimulation.description: Flag marking temporary QA test simulation orders created from Admin Testing Center.

DispatchTicket.title: DispatchTicket
DispatchTicket.description: Non-PII operational order summary for courier pickup queue and admin live index.

cancelledByCourierIds.description: Bounded list (<= 20) of courier UIDs who accepted and then released this ticket.

rejectedBy.description: Bounded list (<= 30) of courier UIDs who rejected this ticket.

isTestSimulation.description: Flag marking temporary QA test simulation tickets.

Courier.title: Courier
Courier.description: Private courier profile containing contact PII, GPS coordinates, and approval status.

CourierDirectoryEntry.title: CourierDirectoryEntry
CourierDirectoryEntry.description: Non-PII courier directory entry for fleet availability, live map pins, wallet tips, and admin approval queue.

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Post-delivery 5-star customer review for a Store and optional Courier.

AdBanner.title: AdBanner
AdBanner.description: Promotional banner displayed on Customer Home with mandatory device-uploaded image.

Coupon.title: Coupon
Coupon.description: Discount coupon code with optional expiry date, single-use lock, and loyalty redemption ownership.

AppNotification.title: AppNotification
AppNotification.description: Real-time notification delivered to a specific recipientUid.

BroadcastNotification.title: BroadcastNotification
BroadcastNotification.description: Internal Admin broadcast notification pushed live to All, Customers, Stores, or Couriers.

Campaign.title: Campaign
Campaign.description: Rotating gamification campaign managed by Admin (Streak 5, Happy Hour, Points Multiplier, Neighborhood Challenge, Mystery Box).

SharedCart.title: SharedCart
SharedCart.description: Live collaborative Group Order cart shared via ?groupCart= link.

ChatLog.title: ChatLog
ChatLog.description: Edkawy AI Assistant conversation log per customer.

RegisteredAccount.title: RegisteredAccount
RegisteredAccount.description: Privacy-preserving SHA-256 email hash marker for Customer, Courier, Store, and Sales Agent accounts.

PasswordResetLock.title: PasswordResetLock
PasswordResetLock.description: Audit timestamp of last password reset link dispatch (no cooldown lock).

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator marker document verified via server OTP gate for vortexstore.team@gmail.com.

BootstrapConfig.title: BootstrapConfig
BootstrapConfig.description: System bootstrap pointer recording the active administrator UID.

SystemMaintenanceConfig.title: SystemMaintenanceConfig
SystemMaintenanceConfig.description: Global platform maintenance mode, surge pricing, payment toggles, and SMTP settings controlled by Admin.

BlockedEntity.title: BlockedEntity
BlockedEntity.description: Account and store suspension registry enforced across UI and Firestore rules.

StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description: Internal Edkawy team member account with RBAC role (super_admin, support_agent, operations) and active status.

SupportAgentPoolEntry.title: SupportAgentPoolEntry
SupportAgentPoolEntry.description: Non-PII support agent workload index used for least-busy automatic ticket assignment.

SupportTicket.title: SupportTicket
SupportTicket.description: PII-isolated technical support ticket with live assignment and reply status.

SupportTicketIndexEntry.title: SupportTicketIndexEntry
SupportTicketIndexEntry.description: Non-PII operational ticket index enabling zero-get() real-time Admin support queue streaming.

SupportMessage.title: SupportMessage
SupportMessage.description: Real-time support chat message scoped by bounded participant UIDs.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable administrative security audit log recording sensitive Admin actions with server timestamp.

adminId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator who executed the action.

adminName.description: Display name or email of the administrator.

actionType.description: Machine-readable category of the sensitive operation.

actionLabelAr.description: Arabic label describing the sensitive action.

details.description: Detailed human-readable summary of the change.

AuditIndexConfig.title: AuditIndexConfig
AuditIndexConfig.description: Bounded rolling index (<= 200 IDs) of newest audit_logs document IDs stored at /appConfig/auditIndex.

recentLogIds.description: Newest-first list of up to 200 audit_logs document IDs.

EdkoZone.title: EdkoZone
EdkoZone.description: Approved geographical delivery pricing zone in Edku city (zone_1 through zone_5).

Category.title: Category
Category.description: Dynamic Super App store category (home_food, cosmetics, household, clothing, gifts, seafood, grills, bakery, supermarket, pharmacy).

GroupSession.title: GroupSession
GroupSession.description: Live collaborative Group Order room session shared via ?groupSession= URL.

GroupSessionCartItem.title: GroupSessionCartItem
GroupSessionCartItem.description: Live participant cart line item inside /group_sessions/{sessionId}/cart/{itemId}.

Invitation.title: Invitation
Invitation.description: Single-use 48-hour account invitation record keyed by UUID token.

InvitationIndexEntry.title: InvitationIndexEntry
InvitationIndexEntry.description: Non-PII operational invitation index enabling zero-get() real-time Admin listing.

InvitationLock.title: InvitationLock
InvitationLock.description: SHA-256 email hash lock preventing duplicate active pending invitations.

SalesAgent.title: SalesAgent
SalesAgent.description: Private PII profile for Sales Agent account isolated to self and Admin.

SalesAgentDirectoryEntry.title: SalesAgentDirectoryEntry
SalesAgentDirectoryEntry.description: Non-PII Sales Agent operational ledger & commission wallet stats.

ReferralCodeEntry.title: ReferralCodeEntry
ReferralCodeEntry.description: Non-PII O(1) lookup index mapping AGENT-XXXX referral codes to Sales Agent UIDs.

ReferralAccount.title: ReferralAccount
ReferralAccount.description: Non-PII CRM record of an account referred by a Sales Agent.

Commission.title: Commission
Commission.description: Sales Agent commission ledger record per delivered order with 24h escrow maturity.

PayoutRequest.title: PayoutRequest
PayoutRequest.description: PII-isolated Sales Agent withdrawal request (Vodafone Cash / InstaPay, min 100 EGP).

PayoutRequestIndexEntry.title: PayoutRequestIndexEntry
PayoutRequestIndexEntry.description: Non-PII operational payout queue index enabling zero-get() Admin live listing.

StoreJoinRequest.title: StoreJoinRequest
StoreJoinRequest.description: Merchant partner application submitted via /join and reviewed by Admin in /admin/requests.

WalletTopupRequest.title: WalletTopupRequest
WalletTopupRequest.description: Customer Vodafone Cash or InstaPay wallet top-up request reviewed by Admin.

WalletTransaction.title: WalletTransaction
WalletTransaction.description: Immutable customer wallet financial ledger record.

LiveEvent.title: LiveEvent
LiveEvent.description: Non-PII anonymized live activity ticker event shown on Customer Home.
